Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/alist-20237737-xyz $.reliability_note: Record shows the 301 target answers status 200, application/json, 2572 bytes; it is not 'nowhere that answers'.
- netdisk-pan/alist-advanced360-top $.reliability_note: Fresh read of the URL returns a parking-style page with keyword links, not a JS-cookie interstitial. Stored record shows only status 200 text/html 502 bytes, no cookie or JS challenge (challenge.detected false).
- netdisk-pan/alist-xiaoya-pro $.reliability_note: Record shows a 302 to bmh.163.com only; nothing says the domain was repurposed (a redirect is not proof of re-registration).
- netdisk-pan/lark-drive-via-multi-tenant-app-credentials $.identity_cost.kind: Page says no card needed; it does not say the identity cost is an email. The sign-up form lists email or phone, so kind 'email' alone is not shown.
- netdisk-pan/lark-drive-via-multi-tenant-app-credentials $.chaining: 100G per app tenant and 250M per file are stated. 'Google service-account pattern', load-balancing writes and one flat namespace are not in the capture; it says instances are auto-routed by order and read/write permission.
- netdisk-pan/lark-drive-via-multi-tenant-app-credentials $.identity_cost.detail: Form lists email address and phone number. 'Overseas IP outside the mainland', 'distinct credentials per tenant' and the developer-console login wall detail are not stated in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/media-advanced360-top $.reliability_note: Record shows a 302 to plain http (no TLS) host that answered 401, error http-401; no TLS failure appears.
- netdisk-pan/public-alist-fronting-139yun $.tooling: Settings capture supports v3.45.1 only; it does not show the root listing or any WebDAV check.
- netdisk-pan/seven-so-cloud $.free_tier.stated: Page confirms shutdown and migration, but not the 1 TB / 200 GB figures, the '11月19下线' site configuration or registerEnabled false; those are not in the capture.
